status: pre-registered implementation constants; not a fitted artifact

information_sets.full_godeye: simulator future green-power trajectory with episode/time-zone offsets
information_sets.none: current green power repeated over every future bin (persistence)

future_demand_assumption: per-DC current power held constant over the forecast horizon
green_ratio: min(1, forecastGreenW/persistenceDemandW); if demand=0 use 1 iff green>0

bounds.policy: explicit clip; declared bound covers 100% of emitted values and therefore exceeds observed p99

legacy_contract: obs_v32_job_forecast=false preserves each old conversion path byte-for-byte, including the historical flat-path forecast pass-through; V3.2 enabled makes both paths persistence-based
